info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_IT Management System Development API
info.description: The IT Management System Development API facilitates the retrieval of system development details related to banking IT management. It offers access to specific system information through identifying parameters, enabling improved oversight and decision-making. This API is typically consumed by IT managers, developers, and business analysts working to enhance banking services and streamline system processes. Use cases include evaluating system performance, tracking development progress, and integrating IT solutions across the banking sector.

get.summary: Retrieve details for a specific system development resource.
get.description: This endpoint retrieves the detailed information for the system development resource identified by the ID 'RES-100045'. It's useful for understanding the current state and attributes of the resource.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the parameters required for retrieving information pertaining to the system development resource identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the JSON adheres to the schema specified to facilitate accurate processing of the request.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, and the response contains the expected data.

GetSystemDevelopmentResource100045Reques.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation in the IT management system development context.

systemId.description: The unique identifier for the system.

environment.description: The deployment environment of the system (e.g., production, staging).

changeId.description: The identifier for the change request associated with the system.

ownerTeam.description: The team responsible for managing the system.

plannedAt.description: The planned date and time for any upcoming changes or operations.

serviceTier.description: The service tier level of the system (e.g., basic, premium).

availabilityTargetPercent.description: The target availability percentage for the system.

maintenanceWindow.description: The scheduled time window for system maintenance.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the system record (e.g., active, inactive).

version.description: The version number of the system.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the system record was last updated.

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: The identifier used to correlate logs across services.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing occurred.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the system request.

GetSystemDevelopmentResource100045Respon.description: Schema that represents the response for the system operations GET request.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer Token for authentication. The token must be a valid JSON Web Token (JWT) that is sent in the authorization header of the HTTP request.
